config.label: Base URL of the TrustScore registry
config.description: Base URL of the TrustScore registry. Defaults to the public production API; override only for a self-hosted or staging instance.

config.label: Leave empty (recommended): the server generates an Ed25519 key in ~/
config.description: Leave empty (recommended): the server generates an Ed25519 key in ~/.trustscoreagent and signs its ratings with the matching did:key. Setting a DID here overrides that key, so ratings are sent unsigned and count at half weight.
